provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning a Bounty Hunting Business

examples.psychological_goal: 一句假设把观众的拥有幻想变成共同语境
examples.expression_mechanism: 第二人称幻想式开场（you want to own a X business）
examples.example_text: Okay, you want to own a bounty hunting business
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用“你想拥有一门X生意”直接开局，零铺垫进入主题
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该具体行业对象

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话否定观众已有的认知框架，制造必须看下去的缺口
examples.expression_mechanism: 前提否定重构（that X is not actually a X）
examples.example_text: That reward you're hearing about is n't actually a reward.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用“你听到的X其实不是X”打破浪漫想象
examples.negative_instruction: 重构必须紧跟解释，不能只剩悬念

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句身份判定完成行业定位翻转
examples.expression_mechanism: 身份重命名（literally a loss prevention subcontractor）
examples.example_text: You are literally a loss prevention subcontractor for an insurance product.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用“你其实是某个更大系统的止损外包”重命名主角
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该具体系统名称

examples.psychological_goal: 用最短句宣布最硬规则，制造不安
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定式短判词（you will not get paid for trying）
examples.example_text: You won't get paid for trying
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用极短否定句交付行业最残酷规则
examples.negative_instruction: 判词前必须先铺好“顺利情形”的对照

examples.psychological_goal: 用时薪换算把名目金额打回日常工资坐标
examples.expression_mechanism: 单位换算去魅（divide by hours → per hour wage）
examples.example_text: Divide that by 60 hours, and you'll earn about $20 per hour, on which you'll still have to pay self- employment tax
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把大数字除以工时换算成时薪来重置期望
examples.negative_instruction: 不要忘记补上税后口径

examples.psychological_goal: 纠偏“买装备=投资”的新手错觉并给出真实资产
examples.expression_mechanism: 错觉否定+真因肯定（devices bring no case, only relationships）
examples.example_text: But here lies the real problem. None of those devices bring a single new case. Cases come only through relationships with bail bond agencies
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先否定表面投资、再指出真正驱动收入的资产
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该具体装备清单

examples.psychological_goal: 用最重的法律定性制造惊吓点
examples.expression_mechanism: 短句重罪定性（this is considered criminal kidnapping）
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用极短句交付最高量级的风险定性
examples.negative_instruction: 重罪定性必须有前文规则铺垫支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 把法律风险换算成灭顶级财务后果
examples.expression_mechanism: 时间尺度对撞（one afternoon vs years of profits）
examples.example_text: One serious mistake made in one afternoon can wipe out the profits from years of successful cases
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用“一个下午对数年”的时间对撞表达风险量级
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该具体后果表述

examples.psychological_goal: 把核心资产从有形物重定义为关系
examples.expression_mechanism: 资产重定义（not vehicle or equipment, but relationships）
examples.example_text: most valuable asset in this business is n't any vehicle or equipment. It's your relationship with bail bond agencies.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用“最值钱的资产不是A也不是B，而是C”的重定义句
examples.negative_instruction: 重定义后必须解释C如何产生收入

examples.psychological_goal: 用“算一笔完整的账”预告聚合级回报
examples.expression_mechanism: 聚合预告式换挡（let us calculate a full month）
examples.example_text: Now, let's calculate a full month in this business
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用“来算一整月”把碎片信息聚合成总账
examples.negative_instruction: 换挡句之后必须真的交付完整总账

examples.psychological_goal: 展示扩张对到手收入的吞噬
examples.expression_mechanism: 成本收入对照（costs rise to X, owner income only Y）
examples.example_text: increase to around $30,000. The owner's net income increases to only $5,800 per month
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用“成本涨到X、老板只拿Y”的对照讲规模悖论

examples.psychological_goal: 把观众最想知道的问题正式摆上台面
examples.expression_mechanism: 悬念点名式换挡（the question everyone wants to know）
examples.example_text: So, let's answer that question that everyone wants to know
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用“现在回答大家都想问的问题”收拢注意力
examples.negative_instruction: 点名后必须立即给出量化回答

examples.psychological_goal: 推翻“努力决定收入”的默认归因
examples.expression_mechanism: 归因反转（has nothing to do with how hard you worked）
examples.example_text: And that difference has nothing to do with how hard you worked.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用“与努力无关”的归因反转制造认知冲击
examples.negative_instruction: 反转后必须给出真正的决定因素

examples.psychological_goal: 用否定加肯定完成行业身份重定义
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定肯定对仗（not a business about X, a business about Y）
examples.example_text: This is not actually a business about finding fugitives and collecting rewards. It's a business about acquiring case relationships
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用“这不是关于X的生意，而是关于Y的生意”收束全片
examples.negative_instruction: Y 必须能用前文证据逐条支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 把回报归属校准到特定经营心态
examples.expression_mechanism: 人群校准句（more rewarding for those who view it as risk management）
examples.example_text: it will be more rewarding for cautious operators who view it as risk management, rather than those who are attracted by the bond amount
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用“更回报把它当X做的人”筛选并安抚目标观众

examples.psychological_goal: 一句总结宣告信息交付完成，自然衔接 CTA
examples.expression_mechanism: 总结宣告句（these are the real financial aspects of X）
examples.example_text: These are the real financial aspects of the bounty hunting business.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用“以上就是X的真实财务面”作为结尾 CTА 的引子
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该总结句措辞
